articleTitle: Incorporation of SmartPV Technology in Zero Energy Building Concept
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In this work, the integration of SmartPV technology (i.e., smart photovoltaic cell-level integrated inverters) in Zero Energy Building (ZEB) concept is proposed, in the context of the strict EU guidelines regarding the transformation of the existing high energy consuming buildings into ZEBs, until 2030. ZEBs feature reduced energy demands, since most of their needs are met by the collective operation of multiple Renewable Energy Sources (RES). Moreover, the economic impact of the self-consumption buildings is not negligible in terms of real economy, as they can safeguard savings for further investments. Under this light, photovoltaics (PVs) are the most promising and energy efficient RES, with reasonable payback periods, especially in Mediterranean climate conditions. The advantages of SmartPV technology for small-scale residential installations, regarding efficiency and total electric energy yield are highlighted. Finally, a sustainability assessment study, using the Life Cycle Cost Analysis (LCCA) tool, is presented.

articleTitle: Modeling the Influences of Cells Characteristics in Battery Bank
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: this paper presents a modeling tool based on Matlab/Simulink, which is used for determining the State of Charge of Li-ion battery packs composed of cells with different characteristics, due to aging or different nominal capacity of the cells. The purpose of this model is to simulate the output voltage in a series-connected battery bank. This model uses reference data base with multiple discharge curves, obtained at different C - rates. That makes the model applicable for much complex battery pack models, made out of many cells and branches. The presented model allows the state of charge of a battery to be obtained for different magnitudes of the current, on the base of interpolations. It is also considered the change in the usable capacity of the battery by discharging it with different currents, proportional to the C-rate of the battery. The model is validated by experimental results.

articleTitle: Implementation of rotor field orientation by voltage control on dSPACE system
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The aim of this paper is the implementation of the field oriented control for a drive system with induction motor and voltage inverter. The control algorithm implementation was done based on the dSPACE DS1104 prototyping board, on a comprehensive experimental stand. The use of the dSPACE board allowed the control system implementation in the Matlab Simulink environment, therefore convenient transition from the simulation studies to the experimental studies. The control model can be later compiled and converted to high level program code, for example, C, to be integrated in the control program of a microcontroller based industrial equipment.

articleTitle: Cyber-Physical Social Space towards Blockchain and Smart Specialisation Solutions
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper presents some general and specific aspects of research on applications that blockchain technology can find in Cyber-Physical Social Space. An electronic supply chain model based on blockchain data authentication technology is presented. The main features are cybersecurity of the system and opportunities to protect customers from unauthorized transactions. The main elements of the technology and the focus areas in the implementation of blockchain applications are discussed.

articleTitle: Digital Implementation of P-Q Control in Grid-Tied Inverters for Educational Purposes
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper presents the development of an educational tool, aiming at the in-depth study of P-Q control concept in grid-tied inverters. The proposed tool is based on the development of the digital control model in MATLAB® Simulink and its conversion into executable code for the TMS320F28379D microcontroller unit. Hence, students are encouraged to enhance their programming and digital control skills, along with the in-depth analysis and comprehension of power electronics systems. Finally, the overall educational tool is experimentally validated through an H-bridge grid-tied inverter.

articleTitle: Design of Embedded Control System for Open Circuit Axial Piston Pump
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The article presents a developed embedded control system for variable displacement axial piston pump designed for hydraulic drive systems with open circuit. The regulation of displacement volume of the pump is carried out by means of an electro-hydraulic proportional valve, in parallel to which a conventional hydraulic pressure controller is connected. The control of the proportional valve is realized by a selective electronic amplifier. Unlike conventional systems with this type of pump control, this electronic amplifier receive a reference that is formed by an industrial controller with an embedded control algorithm. This makes it possible to implement advanced control techniques for control the basic energy parameters in hydraulic drives - pressure and flow. Presented experimental results show the operational capacity of the developed system.

articleTitle: Determining the Places for Installation of Remote Power Disconnectors in Overhead Power Lines
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper describes an effective optimization approach for determining suitable places for installation of remote-controlled power disconnectors in medium voltage (MV) overhead power distribution lines, as well as for evaluating the benefits of their use. The objective function of the mathematical model reflects on the one hand, the costs of purchasing, installing, telecommunications and maintaining these devices, and on the other hand, the reduction of the costs of not supplied electricity as a result of the use of these devices. An example of the application of the optimization approach to an actual power line is presented, which illustrates the ease and convenience of its use.

articleTitle: Performance of Traction System with Induction Motor and Rotor Field Orientation by Voltage Control
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper presents the performance of the traction system with induction motor and rotor field orientation by voltage control. The synthesized control system was implemented on a physical model developed for the electric traction of a locomotive powered by a battery. After introducing the rotor field-orientation by voltage control, the system model, results and performances are presented. Then, the experimental results validate the proposed control algorithm.

articleTitle: Analyzing Possible Network Solutions for loT Communication Protocols and their Applications in Smart Farming
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Smart technologies are playing an increasingly bigger part of our lives they combine different types of applications under a single control point. One of the main use-cases of smart technologies is precision farming the practice of enhancing the farmers ability of making decisions by adding a layer of artificial intelligence to machines. In order to do that, existing machines need to have means of obtaining data from various sensors or sources; also means of transmitting data to centralized data-centers where the information is analyzed by using algorithms for statistical analysis or artificial intelligence. This architecture replicates the principles that are commonly used to construct an loT system.

articleTitle: Energy Harvesting Techniques for Thermal City-Buses
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: A solution for improving the environmental footprint of public road transportation is presented, based on the exploitation of renewables, energy recovery and energy saving techniques in thermal city-buses. Except for the reduction of greenhouse gas emissions, additionally, fuel savings is achieved too. The proposed technical solution consists of energy harvesters (such as rooftop and window-integrated photovoltaics, thermoelectric generators, and piezoelectric elements), battery energy storage units, as well as a smart energy management system. The proposed scheme is suitable both for thermal, hybrid and electric city-buses and it is fully adaptable in regards to the geometries of the bus. Finally, the estimated on-road energy generation is presented, along with the assessment of economic and environmental benefits.

articleTitle: Implemented energy saving system in buildings using the temperature hysteresis
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The present paper considers the operation of an implemented original PLC control system using temperature hysteresis for energy savings in buildings. A description of the system, its principle of operation, its features and advantages are presented.

articleTitle: Model-based Optimization of SEPIC DC-DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The manuscript presents the application of an approach to improve the dynamics of power electronic devices, based on the optimization of the transient process. This approach is realized by using a mathematical model of the converter and a reference curve for the output voltage. In this way, using the initial values of the circuit elements and setting the limits of their change, new ones are determined, through which an aperiodic transient process with a minimum duration is achieved. Thus, better qualities of power electronic devices are achieved not only through optimal synthesis of control, but also by using optimal design of the power circuit itself. The proposed approach is suitable not only for the purposes of training in power electronics, but also for the needs of development and design activities.

articleTitle: Reduction of Electricity Consumption in the Production of Thermally Modified Wood
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The article examines the energy consumption in the processes of thermal modification of wood. The technology requires a high temperature (190 °C), which is why electric heating and various types of oils are used. An analysis of the processes and equipment has been made. Solutions to reduce heat loss have been proposed. This reduces electricity consumption and the price of the product. The annual savings and the payback period for the additional investments have been assessed.

Author Keywords: payback period reduction in electricity consumption

articleTitle: Multi-objective Optimization of Electric Motors with a Kriging Surrogate Model
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Since the electric drive systems are already used in numerous cars and other vehicles as well, the widely varying fields of applications require custom motor design. The most efficient tool for different specified motor designs is the multi-objective optimization tool based on validated simulations. An electrical motor optimization system with a kriging surrogate model based on FEM simulations is developed. The application of this system is presented in this paper. The models and the simulations were created in ANSYS Maxwell and MATLAB. The optimization was performed with the multi-objective genetic optimization algorithm by MATLAB which can be controlled by a simple input-output MATLAB interface.

articleTitle: Testing and Modeling Procedure of the 18650 Lithium Battery at Different Temperatures
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In this paper a two-time constant (TTC) electrical model is investigated to simulate the operation of 18650 batteries at different temperatures. To determine the parameters of the model, a new test procedure is developed, which can be used to obtain a wide range of information on the behavior of the tested batteries after 10 measurements. After performing the tests, detailed information on the constant, transient, and dynamic behavior of the battery over a wide temperature range is available. After, a statistics-based Ordered Weighted Averaging (OWA) aggregation operator is applied to evaluate the results. The general model is developed based on standardized parameters. Worldwide Harmonized Light Vehicle Test Procedure (WLTP) tests are performed to validate the simulation results. The operation of the model has been tested at 4 different temperatures: −15 °C, 0 °C, 25 °C, 60 °C. The simulation results are compared and evaluated with real measurement data.

articleTitle: Measurement and Estimation of the Magnetic Fields in Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: To solve the problem of harmful emissions emitted by internal combustion vehicles such as carbon dioxide, nitrogen oxides, soot and others, the use of electric cars is proposed. These devices operate on electricity that induces “electromagnetic pollution” in or near them. The effects of electromagnetic fields on living organisms are undeniable, but it is not yet clear how harmful they are to humans. In electric car, passengers sit very close to an electrical system that operates at considerable power and for a long period of time. This means that consumers are exposed to artificial magnetic fields. Electric car manufacturers are very familiar with these problems and offer various technological solutions in their design and production. In the present article, experimental measurements of the magnetic fields generated by an electric car operating in different operating modes will be performed and recommendations for its proper operation will be given.

articleTitle: Fluid Flow Modeling in 3D Printed CO2 Absorption Air Contactor
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> capturing and removal are energy consuming processes, of separation of free air where decomposition can be intensified in volumetric cells, called air contactors, where components are effectively separated. In this work is presented 3D printed CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> absorption air contactor with increased high specific absorption internal surface. Modeling of internal fluid flow into the internal contactor structure is made and considerations according to aerodynamic pressure drop and air velocities are made. Results for airflow dynamics in the contactor chamber are acquired and presented.

articleTitle: Educational Laboratory Demonstrator for Teaching Dual Active Bridge Control Principles
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The Dual Active Bridge is actively deployed in DC grids, to control the power flow and connect DC grids with different voltage levels. Galvanic isolation and bidirectional operation are the two main properties but control and modulation of both bridges can be complex. Therefore an educational demonstrator with accompanying simulation software is discussed that can be used to teach the various modulation methods for controlling the power flow in the Dual Active Bridge. Both the hardware demonstrator, simulation software as well as the teaching principle are outlined.

articleTitle: Implemented PLC Control System for Domestic Hot Water Supply in a Recreational Facility
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The present paper considers the operation of an implemented original PLC control system for domestic hot water supply in a recreational facility. A description of the system, its principle of operation, its features and advantages are presented.

articleTitle: Intelligent Design and Control System of Automated Installations for Induction Heating of Products
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper discusses the problems of digitalization of technologies for precision induction heating of billets made of non-ferrous metal alloys, such as titanium, zirconium, niobium, tantalum and some others. Induction heating has some features that need to be taken into account when developing such equipment and technology. At the first stage of the development of an induction installation for continuous heating of non-ferrous metal workpieces, it is necessary to develop a highly adequate digital double that will take into account low thermal conductivity and high temperature losses from the surface. These processes lead to the fact that the highest temperature is reached inside the workpiece, which cannot be measured using pyrometers. But at the same time, precision heating with a high degree of uniformity of the temperature field is essential for the heat treatment of non-magnetic metal alloys before plastic deformation.

articleTitle: Forecasting Electricity Consumption in a National Power System
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: A model of a system for forecasting electricity consumption in a national power system is presented in this paper. Its goal is multi-factor forecasting based on forecast data on significant factors, which are obtained by automated testing of different methods and selection of the method with the least error. The model is experimented with forecasting electricity consumption in Bulgaria.

articleTitle: A Study on Regenerative Braking of the System Battery — Power Converter - Electric Motor of Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Electric vehicles' drivetrain is primarily comprised of an energy storage unit (battery pack or/and supercapacitor bank), a power converter, an electric motor and control. Thus, for purposes of studying the processes in an EV's drivetrain, modelling is performed with such system. In this paper a study of regenerative braking of the system battery — power converter — electric motor is presented. The study is performed on an experimental stand in laboratory environment. In addition, simulation models of the system with two control strategies are made, verified by the experimental stand and presented. Furthermore, a comparison between obtained simulation results is given.

articleTitle: Intelligent Control of Activated Sludge Reactor Performance by DO Consumption Data
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: An intelligent control a continuous Activated Sludge reactor performance is proposed based on batch experiments carried at different initial BOD and activated sludge concentration (X). Starting from a point of DO saturation the time dependent DO drop is registered. The curves obtained are serving for calculation of DO consumption at each specific DO / X pair, mgO2/l.h. The DO consumption rates are used to predict the organic load increase of continuously working activated sludge reactors. In order to measure the performance of the sludge reactor, a set of sensors is required. Depending on the prediction algorithm, several parameters will be subject of measurement such as oxygen, conductivity, temperature, transparency and etc. The sensors are interfaced and polled by a measurement system of interest. The measurement system is comprised of and embedded system responsible for communications and data sampling routine, according to the specific needs the measurement system. If required the system can include data processing techniques and application of specific identifiers like timestamp and geographical position. The raw data acquisition can be performed by direct memory transfer or a specific data communication system in case the measurement system cannot be accessed directly. The aim of this research is to propose an adequate system used to take variety of samples from multiple sludge reactors at the same time and perform remote analysis of the oxygen saturation.

articleTitle: Application of Machine Learning to Automatic Gear Shift Schedule Design of Alternative Drive Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Intelligent automatic transmission shift schedule design has been well established in the last decade. However, due to the paradigm change is currently taking place in mobility sector, which resulted in a rapid progress of Electric Vehicles and Autonomous Vehicles, intelligent automatic gear shift strategies are still in the focus of much research. In addition, the proper transmission shift schedule generation is especially important from the viewpoint of energy efficiency optimizing algorithms, which is affected by the driving style, power losses, etc. Fundamentally, conventional shift schedule design relies on lookup tables obtained from test-bench measurements and real-world driving measurements. During real time test data collection, the measurement of some variables may be impractical and/or patterns of important driving conditions may be unavailable during short-distance routes neglecting the comprehensive effects of the transient operation. Machine Learning methods in combination with model-based data generation is a promising alternative, which allows a significant reduction in development time and a more precise calibration by using rich historical data rich. Such models can be easily fitted to alternative drive systems also, which may raise more specific requirements regarding gear shift scheduling issues coupled with efficiency. In this paper the performances of Machine Learning models are investigated in automatic gear shift schedule generation based on simulated driving cycle test data. Results of simulation investigations validate the applicability and efficiency of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Illuminance Meters Calibration - Deviation of the Readings With Time
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The current paper discusses some specifics in the illuminance meters calibration process. It shows the difference in the illuminance values measured during the calibration and their deviation from the real illuminance values. The paper represents statistical results for the tendency for change of the illuminance values according to the selected light level. Identical illuminance meters from same producers and type are investigated. Statistical analysis is made, based on calibration results of over a hundred illuminance meters by ten different producers - grouped by type and trademark, collected for a period of seven years. Conclusions and recommendations are made about the accuracy and degradation expectation of the investigated types of illuminance meters.

Author Keywords: deviation of the readings from their true value

articleTitle: Crypto Genetic Approach in Information Security
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The present work focuses on a combined crypto genetic algorithm to ensure high level of confidential information security. At the data transmission stage of the information system, the algorithm starts with generating two arbitrary non-coprime numbers, determining a least common multiple and a great common divisor, and producing private and public keys. First, the information is encrypted with a public key to obtain the initial cipher. The initial cipher is additionally manipulated by applying operators of the genetic algorithm. Final cipher is produced. At the receiver, the final cipher first is manipulated by operators of the genetic algorithm. The initial cipher is to restored. Then, a private key is applied to obtain the transmitted information. The main contribution of the present study is the introduction of random generated two non-coprime numbers in the determination of the public and private key at the beginning of the algorithm, which enriches the asymmetric crypto technique and expanses substantially the application area of asymmetric RSA crypto codes.

articleTitle: Stratified Layer Composite Material for Radar Anti-reflective Coating
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: A composite material design that minimizes the radar reflection in S and X bands for at least two different ma-terials to be cloaked is proposed. The designed layered anti- reflective coating has tunable parameters, tailored depending on dielectric properties of the body that would be covered by it. The designed coating structure is built as a stratified sequence of parallel layers. A model accurately describing the reflection and transmission of the entire composite material stack, which includes the surface underneath to be cloaked, is developed for all angles of incidence, and for both “p” and “s” polarizations. Additionally, a generalized model, accounting for desired or unintended dielectric anisotropy of the anti-reflective coating is described. Based on the proposed model, specific practical solutions were developed separately for two surfaces - reinforced concrete, and aluminum oxide ceramic. The dielectric constants of these materials with military significance are taken as described in the literature, and the anti-reflective coating's parameters, suitable for the two specific surfaces are found.

articleTitle: Frequency Domain Modeling of Multiphase DC-DC converter with Automotive Application
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The 48V bus is currently beginning to be embraced by automotive OEMs to meet the everincreasing requirements for CO2 emissions. The adoption of this bus, while keeping the 12V alive is a major task for the bidirectional converter that connects them. Its reliability in case of malfunction in either software or hardware is a very important task of the system. This paper investigates some of the possible malfunctions that can happen in this converter using both simulation and experimental kits, that are commercially available.

articleTitle: Magnetoelectric Energy Harvesting Device
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the study of the magnetoelectric energy harvesting device consisting of two parts: magnetoelectric element and conversion unit. Magnetoelectric structure of Metglas/GaAs/Metglas is most effective convert of magnetic energy at frequencies from 40 to 150 kHz, where output voltage equal of 3 V and current of 2 rnA at the output from the conversion unit. The output voltage was 5 V at frequencies from 95 to 105 kHz. A prospective direction for further development of the energy harvesting is the use of magnetoelectric gradient structures.

articleTitle: Education Practice for Electrical Engineering Students in COVID-19 Situation. Lesson Learned and Future Application
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In this article we consider the approaches used during the period of study in the conditions of COVID-19 in relation to students of electrical engineering at Nikola Vaptsarov Naval Academy (NVNA). The main focus is on innovative approaches and their future use in training in order to improve the overall process.

articleTitle: 3D Printed Polymer Composite Magnetic Material by Stereolithography Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In this work, a method for magnetic compositions production suitable for 3D printing by stereolithography (SLA) is presented. Method is applied for soft-magnetic composite material SLA 3D printing. It is used for toroidal magnetic core sample production. 3D printing production sequence is presented and it is further used for test samples manufacturing by the SLA technology. Composite magnetic material properties of these test samples are measured in order to estimate nonlinearity of magnetic permeability and magnetization curve. Proposed method and corresponding composite magnetic material are suitable for fast fabrication of complex shaped magnetic cores by SLA additive technology and 3D volumetric control of magnetic properties.

articleTitle: Computer-Aided Design of Current Transformer for Power Electronics Converters with Voltage Feedback
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The article presents implementation of a computer application for current transformer design, based on classical methods, into the design of specific transformer. The transformer is produced with toroidal magnetic core, based on magnetic material with Flat hysteresis loop and provides galvanic separation in power electronic converters between the power and the control unit. In the previous works the basic requirements to soft magnetic materials for the toroidal magnetic core, design parameters as well the estimation of the current transformer errors are discussed. Also the computer aided design was described and illustrated with a part of the user interface. The new approach in the article is to incorporate a computer application for particular application - design of transformer that operates in current mode.

articleTitle: Impact of Iron Loss on Performance of Speed Sensorless MRAS Estimator for Induction Machines
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In this work, the impact of iron loss on speed estimation performance of the conventional rotor flux error-based model reference adaptive system (MRAS) estimator is investigated in case of induction machines (IMs). In addition, two improved MRAS-type estimators are proposed to reduce the estimation error caused by iron loss. The first approach takes into account iron loss resistance by its nominal constant value. But in the second case, iron loss is frequency dependent. All three estimators are compared by simulations. The results show that the MRAS estimators with iron loss compensation can reduce the speed estimation error and the frequency dependent iron loss compensation method provides the highest accuracy.

articleTitle: Charging Station for Electric Vehicles, Based on Micro Gas Turbine, Fuel Cell and Supercapacitor
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In current research a hybrid autonomous supplying system for electric vehicles applications is presented. The hybrid system is consisted of fuel cell, micro gas turbine and supercapacitor. There are realized with averaged models in MATLAB/Simulink environment. The supplying elements are connected to a DC bus for charging a different type of EV s. In this case as a load is use two EV s: BMW -i3 and Nissan Leaf. This system can operate autonomously in hard-to-reach places where there is no supplying from the distributed grid and other sources. With the help of the developed model, the optimal value of the supercapacitor has been determined in order to minimize the costs for the construction of the charging station.

articleTitle: Artificial Neural Network Modeling of a Synchronous Reluctance Motor
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Artificial neural networks are applied in different application areas, and electrical machine implementation is one of them. The structures, resembling the motor behavior like motor controllers, observers, parameter prediction units, can also be modeled with artificial neural networks. Choosing network structure, layer, and neuron numbers play a critical role to make the model successful. In this study, multilayer feedforward and recurrent neural networks are trained with various layer and neuron numbers to compare their speed and torque tracking performances. The average training time for each combination and optimal window for neuron and layer numbers are also evaluated.

articleTitle: Implementation of Simplified Method for Constant V/F Speed Control of 3-phase Induction Motor
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper describes a simple method for generating three SPWM (Sinusoidal Pulse Width Modulated) signals, with ability of smooth frequency adjust and keeping the constant ratio between voltage and frequency of the resulting sine signal. A midrange 8-bit PIC microcontroller is used, running at 4MHz system clock frequency.

articleTitle: Virtual Design of Physical Processes
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper discusses prospects of using virtual reality technologies in visual design of physical processes. Also, this paper discusses positive aspects that can give a like program products and possible disadvantages that can appear in a case of an integration the like products in laboratory conditions. A goal of this paper is a consideration of modern game engines to study their possibilities for the visual design physical processes of different kinds, for example, such as the physical modeling of new materials for microwave electronics or the design of materials for construction. Main instruments that to use as a base for a work with physics are discussed in this paper. Positive and negative aspects that can appear in a case of a choose of the specific game engine are discussed in this paper.

articleTitle: Modelling the Magnetic Field Inside a Hand Separator with Permanent Magnet
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This article focuses on a mechanism with permanent magnets designed for separation of ferromagnetic impurities from bulk and determining of magnetic permeability. It is a study of the picture of the magnetic field inside a mechanism with permanent magnets which is used for laboratory work with students. Attention is paid to the characteristics of the field intensity and suggest an approach to determine the magnetic forces.

articleTitle: Photovoltaic Energy Usage for Public Educational Building: A Case Study
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This work presents a case study of a photovoltaic energy system for public educational building. The aim of the case under consideration is to provide technical measures to improve the energy efficiency of the building, according to the technical specification and current regulations. Public educational buildings are mainly used during daylight hours, where solar power will be used for own consumption. Analysis of the energy usage for public building is made and an estimation on a daily basis shows optimal requirements for such systems. Achieved results could be used in the design process of public buildings autonomous electric power supply systems, zero energy building and near zero energy building concepts.

articleTitle: Wire grounding electrode placed near cylindrical multi-layered ground non-homogeneity
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Analysis and realization of grounding system fulfilling technical requirements, very often require analysis of the influence of soil non-homogeneity on grounding characteristics. In some cases, non-homogeneity can be approximated as vertical homogeneous cylindrical domain. Such non-homogeneities are various tubes, wells or pillar foundation. In this paper, the procedure for modeling of soil non-homogeneity as multilayered cylindrical domain is presented. The approach is based on using the Method of Moments and Green's function, applicable for analysis of grounding electrodes placed in the surrounding soil. Within that, particular procedure for grounding electrode formed of finite number of wires is described. It has been applied on problem of vertical electrode in the vicinity of well having concrete cylindrical shell.

articleTitle: Experimental Performances of the Battery Charging System of an Autonomous Locomotive
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper presents the experimental results of the battery charging system of an autonomous electric locomotive. In this goal, the traction converter is controlled by a dedicated strategy so it operates as boost rectifier. The main objective of the control strategy is to obtain a good power quality to the grid (unity power factor and low distortion of the current). The control strategy was implemented on the dSPACE DS1104 prototyping board and it corresponds to a cascade two loops control system: inner one that controls the grid current and extern one that controls the charging current. The correct implementation of the control algorithm was proved by the experimental results obtained on a specially designated stand. The experimental results show the very good performances of the entire system, respectively, the currents absorbed from the power grid have low harmonic distortion factor and the power factor has very close to the unity value.

articleTitle: Forecasting Electricity Consumption with Intelligent Hybrid Model
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In this paper, an Extreme Learning Distributed Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Architecture (ELDANFA) model has been presented. It has been tested with real data for predicting energy consumption at an electrical substation in the South-Central region, near Plovdiv, Bulgaria. The main goal of this hybrid intelligent structure is to reduce the computational burdens of neuro-fuzzy models and to keep prediction error to a minimum. The obtained results prove that the proposed model predicts accurately electricity consumption. It is also suitable for real-time applications due to the reduced number of fuzzy rules and the small number of parameters updated during the learning procedure.

articleTitle: Modeling of Thermally Activated Fe2O3 / Li2CO3 Electrochemical Cell
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In this work, modeling and testing of thermally activated electrochemical cell with potentially significant energy density is performed. It is a Fe2O3 | Li2CO3 electrochemical cell, operating at temperatures above 723 °C. Coupled air flow and temperature distribution model has been created to estimate internal operational conditions for thermal stimulation at solid anode electrode and liquid electrolyte. Estimated results for battery internal equivalent circuit are presented. Cell parameters are temperature related and shows huge dispersion according to non-homogenous temperature distribution. Electrochemical cell is applicable for energy storage and CO2 capturing devices.

articleTitle: Some Specifics in Field Modeling, Taking into Account the Coupling of Thermal, Mechanical and Physicochemical Features
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper presents some characteristic features of the modeling of coupled fields in electromagnetic systems and the possibilities for taking into account the changes in the physical structure, properties of materials and field characteristics resulting from the development of the working process of the devices. Examples are given that illustrate the specifics and stages of modeling of interconnected fields and the development of processes in the studied objects.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Possibilities for Realization of the PTG Technology in RES
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This article presents an analysis of the possibilities for the implementation of technologies for the transfer of energy to gas, describing the various challenges: technical, economic and environmental. Power-to-Gas is a long-term storage technology that uses existing gas infrastructure. In the absence of energy for cogeneration and / or heating and lighting, Power - to - Gas technology can be used to convert electricity into hydrogen or methane. With a high share of volatile renewable energy sources, there is a need for energy storage to balance supply and demand at different times for different regions and localities.

articleTitle: Experimental Evaluation of the Purification of Waste Materials with Belt Type Permanent Magnet Separator
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper presents research on particular type separator with permanent magnets designed for separation of ferromagnetic impurities from bulk or waste products. The area of application of the separators with permanent magnets is rather wide – from filtering of powdered or granulated materials in industry to purification of cell membrane proteins in scientific laboratories. The advantages of the permanent magnets separators are environmental friendliness, energy economy and mobility and define the feasibility of their further perfection and their effective use. It is of significant importance for the optimal usage of these type separators that the proper computation be made concerning the magnet system, the magnetic forces within the working area and the main parameters that influence the process of separation.

articleTitle: Object-Oriented Modelling of Home Automation Management System
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: As new technologies advance and become more accessible, the integration of home automation systems has become very popular in recent years. Such systems should be managed by a well-designed software, which offers all the needed functionalities a user can require. This paper presents an object-oriented model of a home automation management system with the means of Unified Modelling Language (UML) that includes the specific functional requirements and classes and is further developed with programming code in Java.

articleTitle: Increasing Physics Engine Realism Using Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The present work proposes an approach for increasing the degree of realism in game and simulation engines used in software simulations. Using neural networks, it is aimed to simulate kinematics applied in simulations such as aeroplane flight, signal propagation and the variety of simulations in the entertainment game industry in order to generate realistic events like clutter, earthquakes and crash events. The scope of this work is to devise an approach of an efficient way to simulate vehicle physics, movements and subjecting forces as well as generating a variety of realistic events during the combination of certain factors, faults and improper engineering to provide a feeling of realism to the end user. This can be increasingly important when simulating tyres on various surfaces and suspension under different mechanical conditions. This will be achieved by using real world data to teach a neural network. The results of this approach can be implemented in game engines, training vehicle simulators and etc. which will be a subject of future work.

articleTitle: Active load for testing the control algorithms of traction systems with induction motors of autonomous locomotives
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The accurate simulation of the load conditions that occur in the operation of battery-powered electric locomotives, mainly specific variable and dynamic loads in the whole range of operation, from standstill to maximum speed, is an essential aspect for testing the control algorithms of traction systems with induction motors. The attention of this paper is focused first on the presentation of a test bench dedicated to testing electric traction converter-induction motor assembly for autonomous vehicles. Then the presentation of the control algorithm for obtaining the load torque is approached followed by some experimental determinations.

articleTitle: SAR Complex Images Subpixel Co-registration
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Generation of correct SAR interferometric images and differential interferometric images, a precise co-registration of SAR complex images is required. In the present study, an algorithm for modeling pseudo SAR images is suggested to illustrate subpixel co-registration. Based on the spectral definition of the spatial SAR images a spectral co-registration algorithm with subpixel precision is developed and numerically experimented.

articleTitle: Influence of the Operational Temperature on the Characteristics of LED Retrofit Lamps
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper discusses experiment carried out with retrofit LED bulbs, put in different lighting fixtures used in domestic and public premises. The temperature change of the LED lamps with operation time and according to the environmental conditions is investigated. The dependencies between the temperature and luminous flux and color coordinates of the emitted light are presented and conclusions are made.

Author Keywords: characteristics change according to the operational environment

articleTitle: Increasing the Efficiency of Technological Processes in Lattice Type Permanent Magnet Separators
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This study examines the design of special permanent magnet separators designed to separate ferromagnetic impurities from organic products. The field of application of permanent magnet separators is quite wide: separation of ores, recycling of waste and treatment of raw materials in food industry, as well as separation of biological products in medical laboratories. This study is a development of a previous study by the same authors related to the separation of impurities from raw cocoa and sunflower seeds in preparation for pre-packaging. The article considers the results of an experimental study of a lattice-type separator with a specific arrangement of permanent magnets. The magnetic filter of this separator is not static but rotating, which leads to increased energy efficiency of the device.

articleTitle: Beta and Gamma Rays Evaluation Gauge
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper presents an in-house designed and assembled gauge for beta and gamma rays measurement. It is meant to operate indoors and to count the beta and gamma events using Geiger-Muller tubes as counting sensors. The gauge also measures the temperature, relative humidity and atmospheric pressure, as well as the ambient light. The data is transmitted via a wireless module to the METER.AC server infrastructure, where it is made freely available under CC0 license while adhering to the principles of findability, accessibility, interoperability, and reusability, i.e. FAIR data.

articleTitle: Modelling of an Electronic Technological System for Induction Melting of Metals
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The manuscript presents a study of an electronic technological system for induction melting of metals consisting of a transistor bridge parallel current inverter, powered by an uncontrolled rectifier and a step-down DC-DC converter. To stabilize the operating mode, two regulators are used - the inverter with frequency control and maintenance of the input current by changing the duty cycle of the DC-DC converter of hysteresis when changing the control frequency of the inverter. The model is based on the use of a switching function, and studies have been conducted simulating the changes in the load during a real technological process. The presented results are also useful from the point of view of the synthesis of optimal control and adjustment of the controller coefficients.

articleTitle: Modelling of Linear Magnetic Gear
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In this paper transient 2D and 3D finite element method models of linear magnetic gear have been developed. Results for magnetic force interaction and force density have been obtained and presented. The transient motion of the plungers of the linear magnetic gear has been investigated. The results from the modelling of the linear magnetic gear are carried out by the Ansys-Maxwell software. Results are showing relatively high force density of the linear magnetic gear design and low magnetic field reluctance at high traveling distance and moving speed.

articleTitle: Mathematical Model of Synchronous Machines for Examination of Energy Flows in Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper presents a mathematical model of synchronous machines with different dynamic modes of operation with application in electric vehicles. The synchronous motors with permanent magnets in rotor are widely used in industrial and mechatronic technologies due to their high efficiency, small size and high torque. The presented model is realized in MATLAB/Simulink. Through the realized models in the laboratory environment different types of research can easily be done. Developed models can be used to study the properties and performance of electric vehicles, nano systems, intelligent loads.

articleTitle: Design of Simulink-based adaptive state estimator in dynamic positioning system of marine vessel
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Dynamic positioning (DP) systems such as marine position control systems have to maintain the position of the ship in a constantly changing environment. Using information from various sensors, the DP system estimates the position, attitude, and velocity of the ship as well as the disturbances caused by external forces such as waves, wind, and currents. The presented simulation model allows tuning and comparison between different wave filtering algorithms such as nonlinear passive observer (NPO), adaptive Kalman filter (AKF), adaptive extended Kalman filter (AEKF), and adaptive Unscented Kalman filter (AUKF) included in the feedback of the control system.

articleTitle: UV Radiation Monitoring Probe
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: An UV radiation monitoring device is presented. The probe is designed and made in-house. It is meant to operate outdoors and measure the complete UV spectra of both sunlight and earth-reflected radiation. The data is transmitted via a wireless connection to the METER.AC server infrastructure, where it is made freely available under CC0 license while adhering to the principles of findability, accessibility, interoperability, and reusability, i.e. FAIR data.

articleTitle: Impedance Measurements for Multiphase Converters
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Measuring the output impedance of a DC/DC converter and matching it to the supplied load can be an important step in designing an optimal switched-mode power supply (SMPS), especially in voltage regulator module (VRM) applications. The available methods for obtaining bounds on its frequency dependence are analytical, experimental and simulation. This paper tries to evaluate the available methods along with its pros and cons for a multiphase dc/dc converter used in a VRM application.

articleTitle: Advanced System for Power Quality Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In this article, using the Lab Viewgraphical programming environment, three voltage transducers, three current transducers and a data acquisition module an advanced system for monitoring the power quality of electricity is implemented. The acquisition of instantaneous values for currents and voltages allows the proposed system to calculate several parameters that characterize the power quality (level components with the root mean square values of measured harmonics, average Fast Fourier Transform, THD factor, deforming residue, distortion factor, unbalanced voltages/currents and so on). All of these parameters can be monitored and recorded within a time frame set by the system user. Thus, by combining the functions of meter, portable oscilloscope and recorder, this advanced system should be configured for the essential tests required to monitor power quality to ensure energy efficiency and performance at any point of supply network to an industrial consumer and not only.

articleTitle: Electronic Starter with Timing Control for Start Capacitor Single Phase Induction Motor
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper presents an inexpensive and reliable solution for control of the start-up process in a single-phase, capacitor-start capacitor-run induction motor. In general it is required to disconnect the starting capacitor at some point during ramp up of the motor. This could be dependent on the speed of the motor or a preset time. The solution in this paper is based on a triac as a power switch to turn off the capacitor, while the criterion for turn off is time based.

articleTitle: On the Influence of the DC-voltage on the Performance of the Active Power Filter
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Nonlinear loads, such as diode and thyristor based static converters, saturated transformers, etc., are typical sources of harmonic currents. These harmonics have detrimental effects on other loads that are connected to the same power supply. An efficient and high-performance solution to significantly reduce the current harmonic distortion is the use of shunt active power filters. The voltage on the DC-side of the active filter significantly affects the filtering performance. In this paper, the influence of the DC-voltage on the harmonic compensation result is investigated. The presented results are obtained by simulation using the MATLAB – SIMULINK software.

articleTitle: Influence of Nonlinearity of Magnetic Material on Skin Effect in Tubes
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The skin effect will be considered on the basis of solving both the wave and integral equations of the skin effect in which the magnitudes of the current density within the conductor are unknown. Both equations are derived under the assumption that the conduction current prevails over the dielectric displacement current in the conductor and that the effect of propagation along the conductor is negligible, so that it is a plane-parallel quasi-stationary field. The obtained approximate numerical results were compared with the exact analytical ones and with results obtained by FEM and very good agreement was found. A massive tube filled with a nonlinear material in the magnetic sense, whose hysteresis loop is approximated by an ellipse, is considered in this paper.

articleTitle: The Effect of the Load on Electrical Parameters of a Three-Phase Induction Device
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The presented work considers a three-phase induction device operating at industrial frequency. Studies have been performed at load mode with ferromagnetic cylindrical details with different thicknesses. The theoretical research was carried out using an electrical replacement circuit, and the experimental research was performed on a real three-phase induction device. Results were obtained regarding the distribution of electric current and electric power in the three phases, as well as the influence of the details configuration on the power factor.

articleTitle: Specific Absorption Rate Analysis of Smartphone
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper discusses and analyzes the process of absorbing electromagnetic energy emitted by a smartphone. The study of the specific absorption rate (SAR) at the depth of the human head was carried out using a computer model simulated with COMSOL Multiphysics software. The computer model takes into account the technical parameters of a working smartphone and the biological characteristics of the human head. The model simulates the absorption process, depending on the type of radiation pattern of the antenna on a smartphone. To validate the results of the model in depth of the human head, an analysis of the brain activity of a person, using a smartphone, was performed.

articleTitle: Exploring the Possibility of Improving the Design of a Fuel Level Measuring Device Using a Compensating Sensor
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The choice of systems for level measurements determined by the properties of the fluid, the design features of the tank, the type of level reading and other factors. This article discusses the results of the experimental study of two automated measuring systems and analyzes the errors in measuring the level of light fuels in the laboratory and real conditions. After research in this work, we have proposed an improvement in the construction of the level measuring system, width a compensating sensor is used.

articleTitle: Antenna Model Based On Magnetoelectric Gradient Structure With Electronic Switching Of Radiation Direction
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper is devoted to discussion a new principle for controlling the wave properties of an antenna, based on the geometric displacement of the excitation point due to the application of an external electric field. The effect observed in magnetoelectric gradient structures is discussed. This effect allows us to assume about the possibility of implementing the above-mentioned controlled process in practical applications. The paper presents radiation pattern and graphical dependencies. The conclusion the introduction of an artificial dielectric into the multiferroic structure will make it possible to control the regions of the magnetostatic surface wave more flexibly into an electromagnetic wave transformation is made.

articleTitle: Application of Parametric Simulations in Learning Process - Opportunities and Benefits
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper presents some possibilities for introducing in the learning process parametric study, based on computer simulations. Examples are given, concerning parametric analysis of electric circuit, as well as parametric analysis of magnetic field. They illustrate the advantages and benefits, which such applications give to the student's education.

articleTitle: Open-Source Electronic System for Monitoring of Some Parameters in LV Electrical Panels
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The present paper considers a possible application of the increasingly popular open-source systems as a complete solution (hardware-software and communication protocol) in electrical engineering work. The main goal of the developed open-source system is to use it to monitor remotely certain parameters in low voltage electrical panels. Based on the collected data from the different sensors and after the respective analysis, the system has the ability to automatically execute pre- set management scenarios in critical situations. To proof the concept, a prototype of the system is built and several experimental measurements are carried out.

articleTitle: Typical Defects of Hybrid Electro-Hydraulic Governors for Prime Movers’ Fuel Control
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper discusses main operating issues found out during overhauling of modern electronically controlled hydraulic actuators for control of steam valves of turbo-pumps and of main and auxiliary marine engines. The impact of mechanical and electrical malfunctions on the engine performance is presented. Control system errors and their influence on of the operational parameters are analysed.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of two simulation models for reactive power compensation in grid tied single-phase photovoltaic systems
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Power losses, voltage losses, consumers being fed energy with reduced quality are often caused by improper or even lack of control of reactive power. Thus, reactive power compensation is vital for electrical systems connected to the grid. In this paper a comparative analysis of two simulation models regarding reactive power compensation in grid connected single-phase photovoltaic (PV) systems is presented. One model considers compensation with a static synchronous compensator while the other - by controlling the PV system's inverter. Obtained results exhibit that reactive power control and compensation can be achieved by both strategies, but control of PV's inverter is more appealing as it does not require additional devices to be incorporated in its system.

articleTitle: Overview of the Possibilities for Realization of the Interaction between RES and Natural Gas
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Wind and solar energy have been used for many years, but it is only in the last decade that their production prices have fallen sharply, leading to a jump in the number of installations around the world. With RES we have more control and diversification than with natural gas. Natural gas is needed to balance renewables until the necessary capacity is built from capacities that will meet energy demand. Expensive natural gas encourages demand for green alternatives.

articleTitle: Modeling and Examining the Performance of a Virtually Variable Displacement Pump Driven by an Asynchronous Motor
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The research examines the performance of a virtually variable displacement pump (VVDP) through numerical simulations. They are based on nonlinear mathematical models of the driving asynchronous motor, fixed displacement pump, connecting pipelines, fast switching valve, hydraulic accumulator and working liquid. The models are implemented by building individual components with acausal connections or through the use of standard Modelica components. This approach allows the simulations to combine models from different fields of physics. The research is focused on the impact of the driving motor dynamics upon the VVDP performance and the influence of the valve control on the motor dynamic response. Different steady state operating modes of the VVDP are examined.

articleTitle: A Special Software to Predict the First Order Dynamic Circuit Steady State DC Response within a Limited Set of Experimental Data
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In the paper the approach, preliminary proposed in [1] to predict the first order dynamic circuit steady state DC response, is additionally extended. It is based on the direct application of the Least Square Method (LSM), by processing of only a short sequence of experimental data obtained at the beginning of the transient exponential process investigation. It has been shown how to complete the experiment at its initial stage with acceptable result. This can reduce significantly both the experimental time and energy resources. The developed software can help the user to manage and stop the experiment. It is based on Scilab software platform, which facilitates the mathematical algorithm already proposed.

articleTitle: Study of Buck Converter under Supply Voltage Variations
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In the presented work, the influence of the supply voltage variations of the electric transport contact networks on the operation of a buck converter in different control algorithms is researched. The studies were performed at constant frequency and pulse width modulation (PWM) and at variable frequency, as well as at constant pulse duration in “ON” state. The results of the study confirm the advantage of control of buck converter with variable frequency at lower supply voltages. The current pulsation for the example is approximately twice as small with variable frequency control.

articleTitle: A Retrofit Method for Upgrading the Speed Control System of Low Speed Marine Engines
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper discusses the retrofit project performed onboard of passenger vessel with Sulzer auxiliary engine - replacing of the old Woodward “Dual Dynamics 1000” controller unit with Woodward “2300” controller, the installation of new power supply and speed sensors.the testing and commissioning of the new control system and the main advantages achieved.

articleTitle: Parametric optimization of adaptive wave filter using an objective function
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Wave filtering is one of the mandatory features of the state estimators in a dynamic position system. The optimization of statistical parameters of these state estimators can be done by covariance matching algorithms and appropriate objective (cost) functions. The proposed cost function has predictive behavior, based on some tuning parameters, which control the quality of wave filtering. These parameters assure convergence of the solution and consistent results in different adaptive algorithms based on the Kalman filter framework as AKF, AEKF, and AUKF.

articleTitle: Capacitance of Narrow Strip in Tall Rectangular Cross-section Envelope
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The 2D capacitance of a thin (zero thickness) strip in the center of rectangular cross section grounded envelope can be evaluated using the formulas for 2D “corner” geometric capacitances or permeances. If the width of the strip is larger than the height of the envelope the known corner capacitance for infinitely wide strip can be used. Because the exact solution for narrow strip contains difficult to evaluate series simpler approximate formulas were proposed for particular cases and interpolation is suggested for intermediate value of the parameters. In the paper, using conformal mapping and numerical conformal mapping, a new more exact approximate formula is proposed which significantly enlarge the application domain, up to infinitely tall envelope.

articleTitle: Comparative Numerical Study of Digital Hydraulic Systems With and Without Soft Switching
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper submits a numerical comparative performance study of digital hydraulic systems with and without soft switching. The systems are based on off-the-shelf two-way solenoid valves. A lumped parameter component-oriented modeling approach is employed through the use of the Modelica modeling language. The numerical simulations are conducted in OpenModelica environment. The obtained numerical results demonstrate the potential benefits and limitations to soft switching methods in energy efficient digital hydraulic systems such as virtually variable displacement pumps.

articleTitle: Research into the Z-Parameters and the Characteristic Parameters of a Ship's Alternating Voltage Regulator
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The protection of the consumers against various emergency modes that may occur in ship's power systems needs to be fast, reliable and cost effective. Such protection can be realized in practice with the usage of autotransformer alternating regulators. The paper is related to a new type of analysis of an autotransformer discrete alternating voltage regulator, where the device is presented as a two-port. The main purpose of the present study is to determine the Z-parameters and the characteristic parameters of an autotransformer discrete alternating voltage regulator as a two-port with a load. A Matlab simulation model of the regulator with four levels of commutation realized with thyristor switches is used for the analysis. The non-linearities of the regulator's circuit have been considered in the model. The received simulation results were compared with experimental ones, which showed good adequacy of the model analysis. The obtained results could be used to improve methodologies for designing such devices, which would lead to improved energy efficiency of ship's electrical systems using autotransformer discrete alternating voltage regulators.

articleTitle: Modelling and Control of Rectification Column
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Multidisciplinary system is being created for modeling and control of rectification process by desired product. The plant is realized in MATLAB. For this purpose, is created software in AppDesigner. The control system uses an industrial controller and SCADA system. Communication between the two products (MATLAB and PLC/SCADA) is created through industrial protocol- MODBUS.

articleTitle: Where is All the Water?
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Australia has a very unique climate and water is one of its most precious resources. The Where is All the Water? project is a multi-disciplinary research collaboration that has shown for the first time that low-cost sensor networks in combination with other technologies can respond to the Australian infrastructure problem of great distances and low population. It demonstrated that local gravity measurements - soon likely to be augmented with quantum sensing capability - are a technology that can help us map the underground and assist with quantifying recharge to the groundwater; and that satellites have an important role to play in the management of resources. Overall, large uncertainties are identified in water accounting, with the interaction between surface and groundwater being one of the major sources of uncertainty. Thus, innovative solutions to quantify the fluxes between above and below ground remains a priority.

articleTitle: Hydrogen Production Technologies – A Comparative Overview and Future Developments
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Hydrogen is becoming a more significant energy source supported by the sustainable policies. The gas can be produced from a variety feedstock and With the usage of renewable and conventional source of energy. This paper reviews the hydrogen production technologies, which are present and commercially available together with the future trends for their development. The production methods are compared in terms of efficiency and environmental impact.

articleTitle: Requirements for Balancing Service Providers to deliver Frequency Containment Reserve in Europe
publicationTitle: 2022 22nd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In the past, the reserves were provided by conventional power plants, but the new European energy package is focused on energy transition, where the main role of supply will be transferred to zero and low emissions' technologies, such as storages, prosumers and local energy communities. In addition, the new European legislation defines types of reserves and their participation, after prequalification, in regulation of frequency and active power through the market of balancing capacities and energy. This paper proposes definition of balancing products for frequency containment reserve, technical prequalification of applicants for balancing service provider and methodology for calculation of activated balancing energy.
